name: motion-graphics
title_zh: 动效渲染只认四样：标题条、下三路、浮字、图章
tagline_zh: 视频智能体已想好放什么、何时放、长啥样，就差一个不擅自动脑的渲染工。它把动画参数写死进模板。
tagline_en: Your video agent already decided what, when, and how—this skill just renders it safely. Animations locked into.
desc_en: Deterministic motion-graphics rendering execution Skill for the AI Video Production Ecosystem. Use it when a caller (normally video-production-agent) has already decided what graphic to show, when to show it, and roughly how it should look, and needs it rendered safely: title cards, lower thirds, free-form text overlays, and image/logo overlays, with built-in template animation (title/lower-third
why_zh: 确定性优先：动画参数全部模板化，不靠大模型临场发挥。四类图形各配一套内置动效，渲染结果可复现。
why_en: Deterministic by design: all animation params come from templates, not LLM improvisation. Four graphic types each with built-in.
limit_zh: 只认四种图形：标题卡、下三分之一字幕、自由文本浮层、图片/Logo 叠加。超出这四类它直接不渲染；且它只负责出画面。
limit_en: Only handles 4 types: title cards, lower thirds, free-text overlays, image/logo overlays. It renders only—no creative decisions on what/when to.
title_en: Renders only 4 motion graphics: titles, lower thirds.
